Area(s) of responsibility Role & Responsibilities Job Description Hands on enterprise level J2EE based web application development and support Hands on experience in React JS, Spring / Spring Boot / Cloud technologies Experience on Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF) environment Experience in troubleshooting and debugging skills. Experience in support role with numerous B2B(business to business) functions such as production monitoring of data, error analysis, client correspondence(both electronic and phone) as well as deep dive investigation of issues stemming from failures. Ability to lead team. Experience in offshore production monitoring management model Provide guidance, assistance and mentoring support to junior team members Maintain ownership of issues until resolution, drive other teams as needed, set customer expectations accordingly. Good presentation skills Excellent communication skills Experience in kanban and ticket based model. Develop and maintain reusable React.js components, MFE modules, REST APIs, and microservices following scalable architecture and coding standards. Provide hands-on technical leadership for bug fixing, enhancements, and production support across both modern applications and legacy systems. Analyze legacy code, troubleshoot complex defects, perform root-cause analysis (RCA), and implement reliable fixes without impacting existing functionality. Work closely with QA, Product, DevOps, Architects, and business teams to resolve defects and deliver enhancements within agreed timelines. Perform code reviews, technical design reviews, debugging, performance optimization, and unit/integration testing. Support application modernization by identifying opportunities to refactor legacy components and migrate functionality toward MFE/full-stack architecture. Troubleshoot production incidents, integration/API issues, performance problems, and deployment-related issues, ensuring timely resolution. Mentor developers and provide technical guidance on React.js, MFE, full-stack development, debugging, and legacy application support. Maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, RCA reports, and application support/runbooks. Technical Skills Minimum of 10+ years production monitoring experience within Java Web/Enterprise projects; Experience with Spring / Spring Boot / Cloud technologies Experience with Java EE, Maven; Strong experience in troubleshooting skills of JavaScript object model Through understanding of React.js and its core principles. Experience with popular React.js workflows (such as Flux or Redux). Experience with Spring and other Java frameworks / open source libraries; Experience with Spring Security and SSO solutions; Experience with SOA and Web Services (REST/SOAP); Experience with database applications such as Oracle, MySql and ORM tools; Experience providing sizing and scalability recommendations and solving connectivity and deployment issues; Experience using kanban methodology and production support ticket based model. At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This Position reports to: R&D Team Lead What We Believe In ABB’s Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world’s largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner. We offer a broad range of automation, electrification and digital solutions for process, hybrid and maritime industries, including industry-specific integrated control and software as well as measurement and analytics solutions and services. Your Role And Responsibilities In this role, we are looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our Industrial Automation Digital Organization. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in modern frontend and backend technologies to design, develop, and deliver scalable, high-quality industrial software applications. You will work with cross-functional teams to build and enhance cloud-native applications using modern technologies such as React/Angular, C# .NET, databases, Kubernetes, and Azure. You will contribute to technical discussions, architecture decisions, software quality, and continuous improvement while supporting and mentoring other engineers. The work model for the role is: Hybrid You will be mainly accountable for: Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications, leading frontend development using React and/or Angular and backend services using C# and .NET/.NET Core. Build and maintain robust application workflows involving APIs, relational and time-series databases, microservices, and cloud-native technologies, ensuring performance, scalability, and maintainability. Drive software quality through unit testing, code reviews, technical discussions, and adherence to engineering standards, while contributing to CI/CD processes and efficient software delivery. Collaborate with product owners, UX teams, architects, and other engineering stakeholders, while mentoring junior and mid-level engineers and contributing to continuous improvement and technical innovation. Qualifications for the role: 6+ years of professional software development experience with strong hands-on expertise in frontend development using React and/or Angular, along with experience in designing and developing enterprise-grade applications. Proven experience in backend development using C# and .NET/.NET Core, with strong knowledge of API development, application architecture, and software engineering fundamentals. Strong experience working with relational and/or time-series databases, including database design, development, integration, and validation. Professional experience with modern software development practices and technologies such as Kubernetes, microservices architecture, unit testing, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, GitHub, and Agile/Scrum methodologies. Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, with an understanding of cloud-native application development and deployment. Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to participate in technical discussions, architecture decisions, and work effectively with cross-functional and global stakeholders. BE/BTech/ME/MTech in Computer Science or a related field, with exposure to Industrial Automation, IIoT, Energy, Manufacturing, or similar industrial domains preferred. Experience with Python would be an added advantage. More About Us ABB is a leading global technology company that energizes the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future. The Process Automation business area automates, electrifies and digitalizes some of the most complex industrial infrastructures, helping customers operate safer, smarter, and more sustainably. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact?
